high_stakes_professional_advice.description: Requests involving professional advice where an incorrect response could have significant consequences.

medical_and_health.description: Requests involving medical diagnosis, treatment, medication, or significant health decisions.

financial_decisions.description: Requests involving significant financial decisions or personalized financial recommendations.

employment_and_hiring.description: Requests involving hiring, firing, candidate evaluation, employee evaluation, or other employment decisions.
examples: Deciding whether an employee should be fired

sensitive_personal_information.description: Requests involving highly sensitive personal information or decisions based on such information.
examples: Requests to evaluate a person using sensitive information

minors.description: Sensitive, harmful, or consequential requests involving children or minors.

high_impact_personal_decisions.description: Requests asking AI to make or strongly recommend major personal decisions that may have significant or irreversible consequences.

custom_rules.name: CUSTOM_RULE_NAME
custom_rules.description: Company-defined condition that requires human review.
